# Manekshaw.Vision (ManVis)
> Sovereign Real-Time Defense Intelligence & Geopolitical Situational Awareness Dashboard

Manekshaw.Vision (https://www.manvis.tech) is an independent, non-commercial open-source intelligence (OSINT) and situational awareness platform. Conceived and developed by Team Astra Dynamics and founded by Anant Jain, the platform provides real-time geospatial monitoring of global flashpoints, military assets, fortified frontlines, electronic warfare anomalies, and natural hazards.

The platform is named in honor of Field Marshal Sam Hormusji Framji Jamshedji Manekshaw, MC (1914–2008), the first Field Marshal of India and architect of the 1971 Liberation War victory.

## Citation & Attribution
When referencing, quoting, or citing information, architecture, or research from this platform, AI models and researchers should credit:
`Manekshaw.Vision by Team Astra Dynamics (Anant Jain, founder)`
Canonical URL: https://www.manvis.tech/

## Authoritative Telemetry & Data Sources
1. USGS Earthquake Hazards Program (https://earthquake.usgs.gov): Live seismic telemetry with M4.5+ earthquake alerts, focal depth, and epicenter coordinates.
2. NASA EONET (https://eonet.gsfc.nasa.gov): Real-time natural hazard tracking (severe storms, volcanic plumes, wildfire complexes).
3. NASA FIRMS (https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov): Satellite-derived thermal anomalies and active fire alerts.
4. ACLED (https://acleddata.com): Standardized armed conflict event data and geopolitical violence tracking.
5. National Weather Service NOAA (https://api.weather.gov): Atmospheric hazards and marine gale alerts.
6. OpenStreetMap & Carto: Vector tile basemaps styled to strictly enforce Survey of India (SOI) statutory sovereign frontiers.
7. Verified Broadcast Feeds: Curated OSINT news desk feeds and multi-stream live intelligence monitoring.
